conclusion_scope: Markers follow KiCad9 SCH_PAINTER screen rendering in source Y-up coordinates, using text-height-derived default sizes with m_PinSymbolSize=0. The plotter uses different clock triangles. Decorations are native layer-6 body strokes without electrical nodes; one numbered layer-8 segment retains the external source endpoint. Hidden pins default reject; explicit reveal mode loses visibility and implicit global-power name connections. NC needs its independent explicit policy; alternate modes, stacked terminals and styled NC remain rejected.
